notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.0.8
notes.content:
A few minor fixes and a QoL tweak or two this time-



 Up to 8 pages of save games now supported (hopefully enough for the save-early-save-often folks!). 
It only shows the first few pages until you fill them up to keep the UI clean.


 Notification option added to Accessibility menu, so you can disable the red number for Topic Notifications, or turn them off completely.


 Typo fix- Effected -> Affected.


 Text tweak to match VO when grinding coffee.


 Fixed rare soft lock in Ch4 when [spoiler]talking to detective about Nazari[/spoiler].


 Fix for partial photograph description updating early in Ch7.


 Some glitchy animation fixed at end of Ch 6 for [spoiler]Roth and Hara [/spoiler].


 Ch7 Interface Lab description now set correctly for [spoiler]Hara[/spoiler].


I'm about to head on a long-awaited trip to Japan with the family for a few weeks, so no more finding bugs until I'm back! ;)  



Laters, 

Dave

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.0.7
notes.content:
Got caught up in a bunch of business admin tasks this week- the joys of being a small indie team :P

But found time for a few quick fixes:


VSync option now saves/restores correctly.
Notification setting saves/restores correctly.
Fixed Ä character font issue in German credits.
Reporter description updates correctly [spoiler]when you see her in the vent shaft[/spoiler].

If you have the soundtrack, I've added an optional lossless (FLAC) version of the tracks there too. And it's also on Bandcamp now if you tend to look for soundtracks there, or just want a listen!

Cheers,
Dave

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.0.6
notes.content:
Found some time to hack in a few extra options people have asked for. I'll add these to the options menu properly later, but thought I'd update with just keyboard shortcuts for now, since I had a couple of bug fixes to publish too.


 Added Vsync option in the Limit Framerate slider (drag it to the left). New installs default to vsync on rather than limited to 60fps.
 Shift+F now toggles CRT Filter. (Will be added as separate option in menu later)
 Shift+T now toggles Topic notification setting between On, Minimal and Off. (Will be added as separate option in menu later). So you can turn of the red number notifications if you want.
 Fix for potential soft-lock in chapter 9 [spoiler]where Roth floats off the screen[/spoiler].
 Fixed incorrect description in chapter 7 [spoiler]when Roth is in the interface lab[/spoiler].

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.0.5
notes.content:
Another batch of small fixes-


 Fixed player teleporting to destination after pausing game for 3 sec while walking somewhere.
 Fixed being able to walk through fence in desert.
 Fix for potential softlock after mine explosion if ambient audio wasn't playing.
 Fixed some mouth animation offsets for certain poses.
 Using items on [spoiler]left soldier when climbing on side of building[/spoiler] now gives responses.
 Exiting cemetery on right side now plays same sfx as on left side in chapter 4.
 Fixed incorrect description after dying in crypt from [spoiler]collapsing roof on yourself[/spoiler].
 Added German translation for a missing line and fixed a rogue 's' in a line of German text.
 Spelling correction taught -> taut.
 Fixed missing keyhook in kitchen background in chapter 6.
 Using tape on closed answering machine no longer gives misleading response.
 Fix for leafblower potentially never ending when leave chapel area.

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.0.4
notes.content:
Another bunch of fixes. You keep findin' em, I'll keep patchin' em!


 Fixed walk-to point for cutlery drawer with gamepad.
 Fixed potential soft-lock in hospital [spoiler]after Hara knocked out[/spoiler].
 No longer have to leave and return to find something behind the generator.
 Changed "carotid" back to "cartoid" to match colloquial way Mick says it.
 Fixed Butcher sprite being flipped.
 Removed drop-shadow under Mick on winch.
 Fixed "0" topic notification.
 Fixed potential soft-lock walking back into the Vent at start of Ch8.
 Stopped you being able to walk with keyboard while dialogue GUI is active.
 Fixed mouth alignment for Detective and Annie in some poses.
 Typo fix for Geiger counter description.
 Fixed a dead character still being able to talk in Ch6.
 Geiger counter sound and animation fixes.
 Geiger counter no longer reads low when should be high in one instance.
 Fixed missing German localisation descriptions of doors in Ch7.
 Stopped player from walking to the right in the corridor [spoiler]with Sophia[/spoiler] in Ch9.
 Music volume no longer plays full volume in the lab when it's turned down in settings.
 Fix for hard-lock in Ch7 on bridge [spoiler]if using inventory together while Alec is talking to you[/spoiler]. Hopefully fixes some other super-rare soft-lock issues with background sequences too.
 Fix for flamethrower sound effect potentially never ending.


I'm getting through most of the issues people have been reporting. Most of the remaining ones are super-rare now afaik. But if anyone has hit a soft-lock somewhere and needs a save game to get past it, email me on the support email on the steam page and I can hook you up.

Thanks everyone for playing, it's been amazing to get such a great reception to the game!

- Dave

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.0.3
notes.content:
Working through a bunch more bugs, don't mind me...


 Some potential fixes for Mac display issues (Set to native retina display on first launch) to see if it helps with some reported issues there.
 Fixed text alignment under topics gui when using a controller.
 Fix for rare softlock at end of Ch8 [spoiler]When opening hatch in the pool[/spoiler].
 Also a sprite alignment fix in the same place.
 Fix for inventory not being hidden correctly in a Ch8 flashback.
 Fix for controller ring being placed incorrectly being visible in the same place.
 Mick's head flop in Ch8 now works with controller.
 Fixed some unclickable hotspots that showed up on hotspot highlighter.
 Fix for being able to get dressed over and over [spoiler]in the hospital[/spoiler].
 Tweaked walk-to position when offering a hot beverage [spoiler]to Alec[/spoiler].
 Fix for being able to walk all over the screen after restoring game in Ch3 [spoiler]collapsed Crypt[/spoiler].
 Walkable area fix out the front of the newspaper office.
 Added sprite and hotspot in Ch5 for [spoiler]soldier in underground corridor when he's knocked out[/spoiler].
 Fixed my own name in the credits lol.
 Mick can no longer say the caretaker's inside the office when he's not.
 Swapping answering machine tapes in a certain way no longer causes the description to be wrong.


- Dave

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.0.2
notes.content:
A few more quick fixes- mainly for rare soft-locks some people hit.


 Fix for soft-lock in Chapter 7 [spoiler]Roth being in his room when he shouldn't be[/spoiler]
 Fix for walking through cemetery gate in chapter 4.
 Combine items button prompt no longer persists when it shouldn't.
 Text position fix [spoiler]when attacked at the newspaper office[/spoiler].

- Dave

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.0.1
notes.content:
It's been an awesome launch, thanks everyone for your support! I finally got some sleep and now I've fixed a few issues that some folks ran into-


 Fix for potential softlock where player could get stuck and couldn't move in Chapter 3 cemetery.
 Fix for potential softlock in Chapter 6, waiting for a timed event.
 Music/Sfx/Dialogue sliders now save/restore correctly.
 Fix for dialog option not working with Sarah in Chapter 4.
 Typo fix "bill" -> "Bill"


Thanks for those reporting bugs in the forums, and especially for going out of their way to help with sending save games for diagnosing the trickier ones.

- Dave

notes.content:
Dev stream
Join Powerhoof's Dave Lloyd (That's me!) as I show off The Drifter and chat about the inspiration and design ideas behind it! 

I'm going to show some never-before seen footage of the early version of the demo with some of my programmer art like this-

Demo

notes.title: Investigate The Drifter Demo during the Steam Mystery Fest!
notes.content:
Something's rotten in the city of Mawson.

We've been working hard on The Drifter, and the Steam Mystery fest felt like a great time to show off some of what we've been doing!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36050221/7dcb654de6f46a17373cf02e215bbf1fc6aca19e.png

Updated Demo
The updated demo is live, so if you've missed it so far, you have this week to check it out!  If you've played before, it's the same section, but with some spit and polish and a trailer at the end teasing never before seen gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36050221/526cb6652f53eb8f2c50c15a93ac0d4e994977fe.gif

New screenshots
We've got a bunch of new screenshots we're sharing on the steam page too, so check it out if you haven't for a while. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36050221/06b5749587f5a2b6a54c4eb4070b2adb829d4a44.gif

Steam deck support
The game's also running great on Steam Deck, with it's unique dual-stick interaction controls, if you have a deck, be sure to check it out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36050221/5c68db5b1df0184e8fe223fae8c23fd58288ec92.gif

Progress

The game's still a while away from releasing, or even announcing a release date... but the whole game is playable with placeholder art and temp dialog, and we have 3 artists on board now, so we're starting to really churn through content!

To keep up to date with development, or if you just wanna hang and chat, jump in our discord!

Cheers!
Dave

notes.title: The Drifter Dev Diaries!
notes.content:
Hullo, Dave here! I've recently starting recording little developer diary videos for The Drifter during a dev stream, and sticking them up on youtube. In each I talk about or share some stuff we've been working on, and also talk a bit about a topic, either something about the Drifter, or related to adventure game development in general. 

Check out the whole playlist on youtube!

Or watch the first ep right here-

[previewyoutube=mivFQB7DAmI;full][/previewyoutube]

I'm just recording these during a twitch stream, and uploading without editing, so they're nice and raw and unpolished. But that also means it doesn't take time away from development, and I'll actually keep up with making them!

So check them out if you're keen to see what's been happening on the Drifter!

notes.title: The Drifter Demo Dev Stream
notes.content:
Dev stream
Join Powerhoof's Dave Lloyd (That's me!) as I play through the demo of my game The Drifter, and blather on about its development. 

I'm gonna go into details about the idea behind the game, inspirations, the control scheme, and my approach to writing and puzzle design. If you have any questions, I'll be answering them in the chat too!

Demo
On top of that, The Drifter demo's available all week to try out, so get stuck into it!

Sale
On top of THAT, our past games Crawl, and Regular Human Basketball will be on sale for the duration of the event!
Check out ours, and other Melbourne Games week games on sale here: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/migw2021

Update on The Drifter

I'll be going into this in the stream, but I've recently got a first draft of the whole game playable, albeit in an extreeeemly rough state, so for the first time since putting the demo together, I'm getting new actual real art from a real actual artist into the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36050221/4e8b0c7a6416894fa202d2e5d97bc1714676a277.png

^ Here's some of characters from the second chapter!

Anyway, my hope is that now I'm at this stage, and I know what the whole game even is, I'll be able to start sharing more as we continue building the thing!

- Dave
